jobs.title: Family Life Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$30 - $32 per hour.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Family Life Coordinator keeps the department organized, connected, and moving forward. Working closely with Family Life leadership and program managers, this position coordinates shared priorities, upcoming programs, and operational needs across all Family Life functions. These include Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, Dance, Musical Theater, Playdate, Maccabi initiatives, and family events.

The Coordinator gathers information from managers, brings the team together, tracks responsibilities and deadlines, and follows up to ensure plans move into action. The role anticipates needs, identifies gaps, and brings timely updates and requests for decisions to leadership. Program managers retain responsibility for program strategy, budgets, and staff supervision; the Coordinator supports execution and accountability through clear organization and consistent follow-through.

This is a highly collaborative position requiring initiative, sound judgment, and confidence in working with colleagues at different levels. It combines department coordination, hands-on program support, customer service, and routine administration. The position works on-site five days per week and moves regularly between the office and active program spaces.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Department Coordination and Follow-Through**

* Maintain a shared department calendar and action tracker covering upcoming programs, launches, events, key deadlines, responsible staff, and operational needs.
* Check in regularly with program managers to understand what is coming up, what support is needed, and where plans require coordination across areas.
* Organize and help facilitate Family Life operations meetings; gather agenda items, document decisions and action items, and follow up on commitments.
* Prompt managers and leadership for needed information, approvals, and decisions; provide concise progress updates and flag delays or unresolved issues early.
* Coordinate shared staffing, space, equipment, and communication needs; help resolve scheduling conflicts and bring resource decisions to the appropriate manager.
* Help translate agreed priorities into practical next steps and coordinate with Facilities, Marketing, Account Services, and other internal partners to move work forward.

##### **Program Readiness and Operations**

* Coordinate operational preparation for Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, and other Family Life programs, including schedules, space reservations, staffing logistics, supplies, and equipment.
* Use practical readiness checklists to confirm that rosters, participant information, materials, family communications, and staff instructions are available before programs begin.
* Ensure coaches, instructors, seasonal staff, and other program team members receive timely schedules, updates, and the resources needed to deliver programs.
* Coordinate training logistics and help managers arrange coverage for open shifts, breaks, or absences; communicate coverage gaps promptly.

##### **Hands-On Program Support**

* Provide an active on-site presence during programs and events, supporting check-in and check-out, attendance, participant transitions, setup, breakdown, and family questions.
* Step into program activities or temporary coverage as needed, including recreation, athletics, camp, and customer service duties appropriate to training and experience.
* Support Tikvah activities and participants under the direction of program leadership, following individual support guidance and established inclusion and safety practices.
* Observe program flow, respond to routine operational needs, and alert managers to concerns affecting safety, staffing, or participant experience.

##### **Family Experience and Administrative Support**

* Provide welcoming, responsive service to families and maintain a working knowledge of Family Life programs, schedules, and participation options.
* Coordinate approved program reminders and updates, and route participant concerns or questions requiring a decision to the appropriate manager.
* Partner with the Family Life Administrator and Program Managers on registrations, transfers, refunds, waitlists, rosters, and participant records; assist with routine tasks as needed using established procedures.
* Use basic Salesforce and other department tools to update records, access routine reports, and track program readiness and operational needs.
* Maintain organized attendance records, forms, waivers, and other required documentation, protecting confidential participant and family information.
* Follow established departmental procedures and complete other related duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA or BS degree required, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least 2 years of experience in youth programing.
* Salesforce experience a plus.
* Outstanding customer service skills and experience working in a customer-centric organization.
* Experience and ability in designing, creating managing and implementing schedules, reports, and operational plans.
* Outstanding computer skills, including advanced skills in MS Office and the ability to learn new business software programs.
* Experience working with children age 3-13 Working knowledge of child development is a plus.
* Previous experience working in an athletics/ recreation/camp background, specifically within program facilitation and support.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be well-organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team and effectively engage and coordinate with various stakeholders (both staff and clients).
* Ability to handle multiple projects, setting appropriate priorities, and effective time management while ensuring that all deadlines are honored.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Work to be performed in an office environment located within the Family Life center. Daily rout

jobs.description:
**“See It and Be It” Program Coordinator (Richmond Area)**

**STEAM the Streets | Part-Time Contract | 8-15 hours/week | November–March | $30/hour**

**About STEAM the Streets**

STEAM the Streets is a mission-driven organization that uses media, music, arts, and STEAM education to connect young people to careers and inspire them to see new possibilities for their futures.

**About the Role**

STEAM the Streets is seeking a highly organized, proactive **See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator** to support the delivery of our **See It and Be It** program with our partners at West Contra Costa Unified School District (WCCUSD) Department of College and Career.

This is a **part-time, project-based contract role** responsible for coordinating logistics, communication, and school-site readiness across four participating middle schools. The coordinator will help ensure that the program is organized and ready from initial school coordination through the February assembly week and early curriculum implementation.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with school staff, and able to manage multiple moving pieces with minimal supervision.

**About the See It and Be It Program**

**See It and Be It** is a career exploration program from STEAM the Streets that introduces middle school students to a range of STEAM careers through engaging classroom curriculum and real-world exposure. The program kicks off with our **“This Can Be You”** career exploration assemblies, followed by classroom-based career exploration that helps students discover new possibilities and pathways for their future.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Preparation & Coordination – November–January**

* Onboard with STEAM the Streets and review existing commitments, timelines, contacts, forms, and planning materials for the four participating schools.
* Establish and maintain communication with school administrators and teachers at each site.
* Schedule planning meetings and coordinate follow-up with each school.
* Coordinate deadlines and readiness activities leading up to the February assemblies.
* Ensure January deadlines are met for assembly forms, school site visits, technical checks, schedules, and final confirmations.
* Conduct site visits to assess assembly spaces and document logistics, including room setup, AV/technical needs, parking/loading, student capacity, and arrival procedures.
* Coordinate technical checks and communicate site-specific needs to the STEAM the Streets team.
* Maintain a master schedule and program logistics tracker for all four schools.
* Coordinate catering and materials for the professional development/training session.
* Support preparation and on-site logistics for the December train-the-trainer session for approximately 8–12 WCCUSD educators.
* Coordinate pre-program survey follow-up with participating teachers, ensuring teachers understand their role in distributing and completing student pre-surveys.

**This Can Be You Assembly Week – February 8-12**The coordinator will serve as the primary on-the-ground logistics support for STEAM the Streets during assembly week, ensuring each school is prepared and the team has what it needs to successfully deliver the assemblies.

Responsibilities include:

* Confirm final details with each school prior to arrival.
* Coordinate arrival times and access with school staff and the STEAM the Streets team.
* Ensure spaces, equipment, materials, and other site requirements are ready before each assembly.
* Help coordinate setup and troubleshoot logistical or technical issues that arise.
* Serve as the on-site point person for school logistics and communicate issues to the Founder / CEO as needed.
* Assist with breakdown and ensure materials and equipment are accounted for following each assembly.
* Complete daily follow-up and flag any outstanding issues or changes.

**Program Implementation – March**

* Maintain light-touch communication with participating educators as curriculum implementation begins.
* Follow up with teachers regarding student surveys and other program information.
* Conduct occasional school-site check-ins as needed.
* Track questions, issues, and follow-up items and escalate anything requiring STEAM the Streets leadership.
* Assist with collecting program feedback and basic participation information.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with school administrators, teachers, and education professionals.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to manage deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working on-site at schools and during program events.
* Able to anticipate logistical needs and troubleshoot problems calmly.
* Experience in education, youth programs, events, or nonprofit program coordination is a plus.
* Familiarity with WCCUSD or Richmond-area schools is helpful but not required.

**Contract Details**

**Position:** See It and Be It Richmond Area Program Coordinator**Type:** Part-Time Contract**Term:** November–March**Hours:** 8–15 hours per week, with a spike in hours during the February 8–12 assembly week**Rate:** $30/hour**Location:** Richmond area / Hybrid, with required in-person work at district and school sites during program activities**Reports to:** Founder / CEO, STEAM the Streets

**What Success Looks Like**

The coordinator keeps the **See It and Be It** program moving and makes sure each school is prepared, informed, and ready. By the time the STEAM the Streets team arrives at a school, the logistics should be confirmed, the site should be ready, and any potential issues should already be identified and communicated.

**Success means:**

* Each school is informed, prepared, and ready for its scheduled program activities.
* Assembly logistics are confirmed in advance, potential issues are identified early, and each assembly runs smoothly from arrival through breakdown.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
1. Talent Acquisition & Recruiting

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from role intake and sourcing to offer management and closing candidates.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define role requirements, and develop effective recruiting strategies.
* Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, referrals, job boards, and other relevant channels.
* Screen candidates, coordinate interviews, gather feedback, and ensure a smooth and timely hiring process.
* Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience through clear communication and timely follow-ups.
* Manage offer rollouts, coordinate pre-employment documentation, and partner with hiring managers to close candidates.
* Track recruiting metrics, hiring progress, and pipeline health.
* Continuously improve recruiting processes, sourcing strategies, and employer branding initiatives.

2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

* Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee changes, and offboarding.
* Coordinate new hire onboarding to ensure employees have a smooth and engaging start at Harper.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems, personnel files, and employment documentation.
* Prepare offer letters, employment letters, and other HR-related documentation.
* Manage day-to-day HR operations and respond to employee queries related to policies, benefits, leave, and HR processes.
* Coordinate with payroll and benefits providers to ensure accurate and timely administration.
* Support leave management, employee data updates, and other HR administrative processes.

3. Employee Experience & Engagement

* Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees on day-to-day HR matters.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, team activities, and culture-building programs.
* Help organize employee surveys and identify opportunities to improve the employee experience.
* Support performance review cycles, feedback processes, and employee development initiatives.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and people-first work environment.

4. HR Policies & Compliance

* Support the implementation and communication of HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Maintain and update HR documentation and the employee handbook.
* Help ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and internal policies.
* Handle sensitive employee information with confidentiality and discretion.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR workflows and processes.

5. People Programs & Process Improvement

* Partner with the VP of People on initiatives across talent acquisition, employee experience, and People Operations.
* Build and maintain recruiting and HR dashboards to track key metrics.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Support the development of scalable People practices as Harper grows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3 years of experience in HR Generalist, Talent Acquisition, or People Operations roles.
* Experience managing end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical roles, preferably in a technology or SaaS company.
* Solid understanding of core HR processes and the employee lifecycle.
* Strong sourcing, candidate assessment, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple open roles and HR priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with hiring managers, employees, and senior leadership.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a high sense of ownership.
* A hands-on, resourceful mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Hiring managers receive proactive recruiting support and positions move efficiently through the hiring process.
* Candidates have a positive and consistent recruitment experience.
* New hires experience seamless onboarding and are set up for success.
* Employees receive timely and effective support on HR-related matters.
* HR operations and employee records remain accurate, organized, and compliant.
* Recruiting and HR processes become increasingly efficient and scalable as Harper grows.

**Why Join Harper?**

* Play a dual-impact role across talent acquisition and HR.
* Work closely with the VP of People, hiring managers, and leadership.
* Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in a growing company.
* Help shape both the talent Harper attracts and the employee experience it creates.

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

jobs.title: TA Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
---------------

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

**Role Overview**

We're hiring a Senior Talent Operations Specialist to own the systems and data behind hiring at Reflection, and to build the programs that make our hiring consistent and high signal as we grow from roughly 300 people to 400 this year and well beyond next. You will run our ATS and the integrations around it, and you will build the reporting that tells recruiters, hiring managers and leadership where hiring is working and where it is stuck. Working directly with the Recruiting Operations Manager, you will also turn our structured hiring and interviewer and hiring manager training into working tools, materials and measurement.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own Ashby end to end: configuration, permissions and access roles, reference data, templates, interview plan structure, feedback forms, openings and job setup standards
* Build and maintain reporting for every audience: pipeline health and pass-through, time to fill, decline and competitor analysis, interviewer load and feedback completion, source effectiveness and scheduling SLAs, plus alerts that catch problems before people do
* Keep the data trustworthy: audits, hygiene sweeps and the fixes that follow
* Build the materials, logistics and measurement behind interviewer and hiring manager training, and track completion against our SLAs
* Own our documentation system and tool enablement: the structure and upkeep of our recruiting wiki and onboarding for new team members
* Run candidate experience surveys and turn the results into fixes

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years in recruiting operations or talent systems with ownership of an ATS and its reporting
* Deep hands-on Ashby experience, ideally including an implementation, migration or major re-configuration
* You have built dashboards that people used to make decisions, and you understand recruiting metrics well enough to define them
* Comfort with integrations and automation: Zapier or similar, APIs, webhooks
* You have helped build an interviewer, hiring manager or recruiter enablement program
* You have owned the systems side of a tool rollout across teams
* Clear writer who documents as they build and enjoys teaching others to use tools well
* High agency and attention to detail; data quality is your problem before it is anyone else's

**What We Offer:**
------------------

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

* **Top-tier compensation:** Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.
* **Stock options:** Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.
* **Health & wellness:** Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.
* **Meals:** Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.
* **Life & family:** 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.
* **Vacation days:** Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.
* **Sponsorship support:** We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.
* **Team building:** We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

***Export Control Notice:*** *This position may require access to technology or source code subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Any offer of employment for this role may be conditioned on the Company's ability to provide the candidate with access to such technology or source code in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, which may require the Company to seek government authorization.*

***Candidate and Employee Privacy Notice:*** *We collect and process personal data about applicants for the purposes described in our* *Candidate and Employee Privacy Notice*

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Overhaul is a supply chain integrity solutions company that allows shippers to connect disparate sources of data into the first fully transparent situational analysis engine designed for the logistics industry. Data that is transformed into critical insights can instantly trigger corrective actions, impacting everything from temperature control to handling requirements or package-level tracking, ensuring cargo arrives at its destination safely, undamaged, and on time. We are a dynamic, innovative, and fun team who is highly committed to our customers’ experiences and our Mission and Vision.

**The Role**

As a Key Account Manager based in San Jose, you own a portfolio of Overhaul’s strategic enterprise accounts, accelerating growth by highlighting Overhaul’s Enterprise business solutions that greatly increase supply chain visibility, integrity, and security. Most of your accounts will be based in or near Silicon Valley, though your portfolio may also include accounts headquartered elsewhere. Through your expertise and understanding of each client’s needs, you outline uniquely beneficial combinations of our software and services solutions that deliver on customer and business goals while creating demand for the future.

You are enthusiastic about our service suite and inspiring clients to share in your enthusiasm while retaining current service and expanding future value from Overhaul’s suite of services. You have developed a keen ability for identifying roadblocks and overcoming obstacles to increase business and enhance the client experience. You flourish in a fast-paced environment and are energized by being on the ground with your accounts — this role involves regular on-site presence at client offices throughout the Bay Area, working in person with the teams you support.

**Key Account Manager Responsibilities:**

* Retain customer relationships, while growing the Overhaul service suite within the assigned customer base.
* Interacting with C-Level and VP-Level Executives, driving the digital transformation strategy for assigned account base.
* Maintain existing customer relationships and satisfaction, while gaining new customer contacts for Overhaul services. Create cross-department relationships and value in the customer base.
* Manage the pricing, negotiation, and execution of client contract renewals and expansion.
* While selling existing solutions, work within the business to advocate for solving additional customer challenges, resulting in revenue quota attainment.
* Working with operations, marketing, product, engineering, and data science departments to align future client needs with product and services roadmap.
* Coordinate and partner with Customer Success Management (CSM) team members for strategic business reviews with clients to guide vision and execution of expanded Overhaul services.
* Ability to navigate the customer and the business to reach revenue goals.
* Maintain a regular on-site presence for your Silicon Valley-based accounts — for example, splitting your week across one or more client offices in the Bay Area — while managing any accounts based outside the region remotely or through periodic travel, depending on account assignment.

**About you:**

* Demonstrable history of achieving company revenue goals and growth while enabling a long-term customer relationship
* Capable of thriving in fast-paced Start-Up environment
* 5+ years’ experience in enterprise revenue generating or account management role
* Previous management of Fortune 1000 accounts
* Based in or willing to relocate to the San Jose / Silicon Valley area, with the flexibility to work on-site at multiple client offices across the Bay Area each week
* Previous supply chain management, logistics, law enforcement, and/or cargo security experience
* Ability to travel regionally between client offices across the Bay Area, and further domestically or internationally as needed for accounts based outside the region.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
  + This role will communicate within all paygrades at the customer base and within Overhaul. This is from dock worker to senior executive level.
* Financial comprehension for account(s) forecasting, pipeline creation and management, invoicing, etc.

* Excellent analytical and communication skills with strong business acumen and intuition
* Self-motivated – possess a strong desire to be successful and self-directed
* Passion for fast-paced, high-growth and challenging environments
* Experience navigating a complex, global customers across all departments: Logistics, Operations, Security, Cyber Security, etc.

jobs.title: Service Account Manager
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy customer service and building meaningful connections? Are you self-driven and find excitement in sales activities?

As a **Service Account Manager**, you will have the opportunity to actively seek out, manage, and nurture a portfolio of key accounts within the mechanical contracting industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide exceptional customer service while fostering strong relationships with both new and existing clients. The Service Account Manager will use their expertise and industry knowledge to navigate customers through the sales process and ensure satisfaction with our products and services.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Develop and manage a portfolio of key accounts in the mechanical industry specializing in service agreements, repairs and projects.
* Drive client engagement and satisfaction by evaluating operations through on-site inspections and offer expert HVAC, plumbing and piping solutions that are tailored to client’s needs.
* Proactively generate new business through prospecting, cold calling, emails, and onsite meetings with prospective clients.
* Identify growth potential with existing accounts, analyzing performance, and developing strategies to enhance client satisfaction, retention, and revenue.
* Build and manage a robust sales pipeline, tracking customer interactions, forecasts, and presenting updates during monthly meetings.
* Create detailed proposals for new and existing clients, outlining scopes of work tailored to their unique requirements.
* Follow up with submitted customer proposals on a weekly basis, maintaining communication to address inquiries or modifications.
* Tracks annual contract renewals, engaging with clients prior to expiration for repeat business.
* Identify and pursue cross-selling opportunities for Plumbing services by collaborating with internal partners to deliver comprehensive service offerings.
* Maintain a competitive edge by staying abreast of market trends, emerging technologies, and industry advancements within the assigned region.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and act as a liaison between clients and various departments within SVM.

**EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 2+ years’ experience as a HVAC Account Manager or Sales Representative **required**.
* 2+ years’ experience working with a Mechanical Contractor or related field **required**.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED; or equivalent combination of education and experience) **required.**
* Proficient knowledge of HVAC systems and terminology utilized in the Mechanical Industry **required.**
* Proven experience successfully establishing and managing a book of business **required.**
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude with experience writing grammatically correct customer proposals **required.**
* Proven ability to overcome objections and challenges with customers **required.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to maintain strong relationships **required.**
* Highly proficient with various office equipment and programs including MS Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel), Accounting Software or a CRM **required.**
* Possesses a valid California’s Driver’s License and willing to submit to a DMV report **a must.**

**COMPENSATION & COMPANY BENEFITS INCLUDE**

This is a full-time exempt position. The compensation for this role is $100,000- $170,000 annually and is based on experience and skillset.

**Health:** Medical / Dental / Vision / Life & Disability Insurance / FSA

**Well-Being**: Robust Maternity & Paternity Leave / EAP / Paid Holidays / PTO / Sick Leave / Interactive Breakroom

**Financial Wellness**: Deferred Compensation Plan / 401k w/ Employer Contribution / Employee Referral Bonus / “Positive Pulse”

**Community Investment**: Volunteer Opportunities / Team Building Activities / Employee Activities

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

As a Service Account Manager the Mechanical Contracting Industry, there are certain physical requirements you should be aware of. These requirements ensure that you are capable of performing the necessary tasks safely and effectively. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified applicants who may not be able to fulfil certain aspects of the role. The key physical requirements for this role are outlined below:

* This role may involve physical activity including walking, standing, climbing, and driving to customer sites.
* This role may requirecarrying equipment, samples, or marketing materials when visiting customers which could result in carrying up to 50lbs.
* This role may require working at elevated heights and changing work conditions while surveying customer equipment including construction sites and commercial buildings.
* This role may require navigating through tight spaces, such as crawlspaces, attics, or mechanical rooms to review customer equipment.
* This role may require reviewing and interpreting technical specifications, equipment manuals and other relevant documents.
* This role may require the use of ladders and personal protective equipment (PPE) during customer site visits.

**WHO WE ARE**

At SVM, we are more than just a leading mechanical contractor specializing in design-build commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, service/maintenance, and 24-hour emergency services. We’re a team dedicated to supporting the Bay Area, Sacramento, and Nevada regions with trusted expertise and an unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional experiences at every level.

Our success is built on a collaborative culture that values teamwork, innovation, and doing the right thing. We take pride in fostering an inclusive and welcoming environment where every team member feels supported, valued, and empowered to grow. At SVM, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize their development, well-being, and success.

jobs.title: Packaging Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Allogene:**

Allogene Therapeutics, with headquarters in South San Francisco, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T cell (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease. Led by a management team with significant experience in cell therapy, Allogene is developing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” CAR T cell product candidates with the goal of delivering readily available cell therapy on-demand, more reliably, and at greater scale to more patients.

**About the role:**

Allogene Therapeutics is seeking a highly motivated Packaging Operations Manager to support the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of packaging systems, labeling components, and cold chain packaging supporting the manufacture and distribution of Allogene's clinical and commercial cell therapy products. This role helps ensure that packaging and labeling systems for the company’s first product launch comply with GMP, regulatory, and patient-specific requirements while maintaining product integrity throughout manufacturing, cryogenic storage, transportation, and delivery. This role supports the preparation and launch of Allogene’s first commercial cell therapy product.

The position will be located at Allogene headquarters in South San Francisco, CA. The ideal candidate is an individual who is interested in working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative biotech environment with a willingness and ability to successfully take on new challenges.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Packaging Engineering: Own the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of secondary/tertiary packaging systems for cryopreserved cell therapy products, ensuring product quality and protection across manufacturing, storage, shipping, and clinical-to-commercial transitions.
* Cold Chain Packaging Systems: Support the technical performance and qualification of cold chain shipping systems (dry shippers, temperature monitors, data loggers, insulated containers) by managing Validation protocols, thermal mapping, and lane/transportation validation studies, and analyzing shipping data to drive corrective actions.
* Packaging Design and Engineering: Support the technical lifecycle, specifications, and GMP-compliant documentation of printed packaging components (labels, cartons, IFUs, inserts) and lead Allogene's commercial packaging design and validation - including supplier qualification, cryogenic/transport performance testing, artwork and material selection, and packaging-related risk assessments impacting patient material.
* CMO and Supplier Management: manage chosen CMOs for secondary and tertiary packaging, including manufacturers, contract packagers, and contracted cold chain distribution.
* Artwork and Printing Management: Serve as the lead for artwork implementation, verifying manufacturability, packaging compatibility, and specification alignment while supporting change control and collaborating with Regulatory Affairs, Marketing and Quality on approved labeling updates. Manage print suppliers, coordinate printing and troubleshoot printing issues.
* First product launch: Ensure completion of activities to ensure on on-time launch for Allogene’s first commercial product. Coordinate all packaging related launch activities.

**Position Requirements & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Packaging Science, or a related field with at least 3 years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, with a strong preference for cell or gene therapy, package design and development, and/or cold chain management.
* Knowledge of cGMP regulations and regulatory expectations; familiarity with FDA, EMA, and Annex 13 labeling requirements is a plus.
* Familiarity with cryogenic or cold-chain packaging and autologous or allogeneic cell therapy supply chains is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of artwork management and print processes for packaging components.
* Experience with product launches is preferred.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Process Development, and others.
* Ability to effectively work in a fast-paced, biotech environment while dealing with ambiguity.
* Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a desire to improve upon established processes.
* Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S.

We offer a chance to work with talented people in a collaborative environment and provide a top-notch compensation and benefits package, which includes an annual performance bonus, equity, health insurance, generous time off (including 2 annual holiday company-wide shutdowns) and much more. The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 per year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

As an equal opportunity employer, Allogene is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. We also embrace differences in experience and background, and welcome diversity of opinions and thought, designed to create a stronger and better Allogene that is focused on developing life-changing products for patients.

jobs.title: Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to drive data collection programs, AI-powered automation, and model and data evaluation at our capture facility. Reality Labs builds the next generation of computing across Meta’s Hardware Products mixed reality, virtual reality, and wearables, and capabilities like hand tracking, eye tracking, body tracking, and holograms dependent on machine learning models trained on high-quality human data.Our scope spans the full lifecycle of the data: running the onsite collections that produce it, deploying AI and automation to scale how it is processed and checked, and building the evaluation practices that measure model performance against it. A session in one of our facilities can become part of what teaches a device to recognize a gesture, follow a gaze, or anchor a hologram.If you are energized by hands-on operational work, prototype hardware, and AI-driven workflows, this role is for you. You will be responsible for translating engineering and research requirements into repeatable collection protocols, deploying the automation and AI tooling that scales them, and owning and collaborating with the hardware, tooling, and quality teams that make each collection reproducible.  
  
  

### **Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end execution of on-site data collection programs at the capture facility and across additional labs and remote participant sessions, from requirements intake through dataset delivery and acceptance
* Partner with research scientists, engineers, and technical program managers to translate model and evaluation requirements into collection protocols, participant criteria, and acceptance criteria
* Lead, schedule, and develop teams of on-site collection moderators and technicians, and author the standard operating procedures, training curricula, and certification materials they work from
* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot prototype and pre-release capture hardware, sensor rigs, and multi-device synchronization setup
* Establish and operate quality processes, including calibration, in-session validation, and post-collection audits, and ensure that collections meet participant consent, privacy, and safety requirements
* Design, build, and operate AI and automation solutions across the data pipeline, including pre-annotation, quality triage, and workflow automation that reduces manual effort and increases throughput
* Build and maintain evaluation practices for your area, including gold-standard datasets, model versus human comparison, and the accuracy thresholds that determine whether data and AI outputs meet the bar
* Collect, analyze, and leverage operational data to identify quality and throughput trends, building the dashboards, metrics, and leadership-facing reports that drive decision-making across your programs
* Drive the resolution of risks and blockers across hardware, tooling, vendor, and scheduling dependencies, re-prioritizing as hardware and model training schedules evolve
* Manage external vendors supporting participant recruitment and onsite staffing, and align requirements, timelines, and budgets across stakeholders and facility capacity

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in program management, operations, or technical operations within a hardware, research, or data-driven organization

jobs.title: Program Manager, Registration and Aquarium Operations
jobs.description:
**About the California Academy of Sciences**

Founded in 1853, the California Academy of Sciences is a globally renowned, AZA-accredited non-profit scientific and cultural institution located in the heart of San Francisco's Golden Gate Park. Home to a world-class planetarium, aquarium, rainforest, research institute, and natural history museum—all under one living roof—our mission is to regenerate the natural world through science, learning, and collaboration.

Our living collection reflects Earth's vast biodiversity, consisting of nearly 60,000 animals representing over 800 species. Our research collections are the largest west of the Mississippi, spanning nearly 46 million plants, animals, fossils, and cultural artifacts from across the globe and throughout history. Our diverse team includes leading biodiversity scientists, educators, storytellers, designers, and communicators who are passionate about advancing knowledge and catalyzing action through science and storytelling.

Whether you're conducting research behind the scenes or engaging the public on the museum floor, your work will help connect people to the natural world and empower them to protect it.

**About the Opportunity**

  

The Steinhart Aquarium is currently seeking a Registration and Operations Manager to join our team. Reporting to the Curator of Aquarium Operations, this position is split between registration and recordkeeping (approximately 60% of duties) and managing departmental operations (approximately 40% of the role). As the lead registration staff member, you will oversee the Institutional Recordkeeping Program for the Steinhart Aquarium, and ensure that all records are kept up to date and in accordance with the best practices and industry standards set by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA). Working with minimal oversight and supervision, you will be accountable for managing and maintaining the collection inventory, animal transactions (loans, acquisitions and transfers), births and deaths, transfers between enclosures, behavioral and reproductive notes, and similar program elements. This role ensures that our record-keeping system provides sufficient detail to enhance husbandry, breeding, conservation and medical health advancements to move forward the critical knowledge of species through permanent, retrievable documentation. Operational duties include tracking safety and compliance programs, scheduling meetings and staff training sessions, and coordinating the recruiting and onboarding of departmental volunteers. Work schedule may include weekends, evenings and holidays.

**Organizational Culture**

  

When you join the California Academy of Sciences, you become part of a mission-driven community that values curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, and celebrates its accomplishments together. Staff share a commitment to executing a new strategic plan that will strengthen the organization's financial foundations, cultivate a vibrant internal culture, and foster smart growth to secure the Academy's future.

We hope you are inspired by what we do and are motivated to contribute to our mission. The Academy is looking for candidates who do great work, and we know they may come from a number of different backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification for the position.

This position is based in San Francisco, California. The specific onsite/hybrid schedule for this position is listed below.

**This position is part of a bargaining unit represented by Cal Academy Workers United, and will be subject to the terms and conditions of that contract.**

**About the Steinhart Aquarium Team**

Steinhart Aquarium is one of the most biologically diverse and interactive aquariums on Earth. Home to more than 60,000 live plants and animals, representing more than 1,000 unique species, it offers guests an unprecedented view of underwater and terrestrial habitats.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

A critical aspect of this position is maintaining the Steinhart Aquarium Institutional Recordkeeping Program, and assisting departmental managers in maintaining all protocols, procedures, recordkeeping and standards. Responsibilities related to managing the Steinhart Aquarium's animal database, digital workflow, and federal and state permits are expected to account for approximately 60% of the role. These include:

* Animal Records Database – independently responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our animal collections data in the ZIMS global database, tracking the daily ins and outs of the collection through departmental systems such as PI Reports and Mortality Reports. Trains and onboards all new staff to our recordkeeping systems, policies, and standards, and activates/deactivates staff ZIMS accounts. Ensures that all records are kept up to date and in accordance with the best practices and industry standards set by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA).
* Permits – independently responsible for ensuring that all departmental state and federal permits are accurate, up to date, and renewed on schedule, and that all annual reporting requirements are completed on schedule.
* Formstack – independently monitors, maintains, and updates our digital workflow and permissions systems in the Formstack software platform.
* Google Suite – independently monitors, maintains, and updates our Google sites page, team drives, and Google email groups.
* Graphics – processes new graphic ID requests for the Steinhart Aquarium and Rainforest exhibits. Collaborates with the Steinhart biologists, IBSS scientists, and Experience Studio to create and produce both digital and printed graphics.

Duties related to departmental operations and administration are expected to account for approximately 40% of the role. These include:

* Safety & Compliance – supports the Curator of Aquarium Operations to ensure that we are operating within all safety and regulatory guidelines

jobs.description:
At Ouster, we build sensors and tools for engineers, roboticists, and researchers, so they can make the world safer and more efficient. We've transformed LIDAR from an analog device with thousands of components to an elegant digital device powered by one chip-scale laser array and one CMOS sensor. The result is a full range of high-resolution LIDAR sensors that deliver superior imaging at a dramatically lower price. Our advanced sensor hardware and vision algorithms are used in autonomous cars, drones and many other applications. If you’re motivated by solving big problems, we’re hiring key roles across the company and need your help!  
  
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an execution-focused Senior E-Commerce & Web Operations Manager to co-own the delivery of our web store platform and manage our corporate digital presence as we grow our direct online channel.

In this role, you will be the commercial and operational engine behind our direct online sales channel. You will adopt and scale the proven webstore playbook established by our Stereolabs team, drive self-service adoption for our REV8 sensors and accessories, and rigorously manage our corporate website (Ouster.com) and agency partners to ensure high efficiency, minimal scope creep, and fast execution. Your work will enable Ouster to reach and support customers around the world we previously couldn't serve.

This is an individual contributor role, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, our Stereolabs team in Paris, and external agency and implementation partners.

**Responsibilities**

**Webstore Ownership & GTM Execution**

* Co-Own Project Delivery: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product Strategy, Sales, IT, Legal, Audit, Finance, and Support) to help deliver our webstore launch in a phased approach, then drive the store's day-to-day operations after go-live.
* Playbook Execution: Adopt and adapt the operational e-commerce workflow from our Stereolabs team (Paris) using Shopify and our implementation partner.
* Catalog Management: Own SKU onboarding, implementation of pricing and promotions (in partnership with sales and product strategy), bundles, datasheets, and customer-facing descriptions for Ouster REV8 sensors, cables, and components. This includes managing ongoing changes to SKUs, pricing, and product content as applicable.
* Revenue & Self-Service Growth: Build campaigns and conversion flows to route low-touch, long-tail accounts through self-service e-commerce.
* Performance Reporting: Define and report on webstore KPIs (traffic, conversion, order volume, self-serve revenue, quote deflection) and use them to prioritize improvements.

**Corporate Web Operations & Agency Management (Ouster.com)**

* Website Unification: Lead the consolidation of Stereolabs.com into Ouster.com to streamline our global digital footprint and domain architecture. This includes content migration, redirect mapping, and preservation of search rankings and inbound traffic.
* Agency & Vendor Management: Directly manage our external web agency partners with strict oversight on scope, deliverables, speed, and budget. Shift routine work in-house and right-size the agency engagement over time.
* In-House CMS Management: Use Sanity CMS to swiftly build and launch new landing pages, product pages, and digital assets internally without relying heavily on agency development.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Experience: 5+ years owning e-commerce and/or web operations within B2B Hardware, B2C Consumer Tech, B2B Software, Industrial Tech, Marketplaces, or Semiconductor sectors.
* E-Commerce Stack: Hands-on admin experience with Shopify / Shopify Plus, product information architecture, catalog management, and checkout flows.
* Modern CMS & Web Stack: Proven experience with Sanity (or other headless CMS platforms) and managing web design/build projects.
* Site Migrations: Has led at least one domain consolidation or site migration with SEO preserved.
* Agency Management: Demonstrated track record of holding creative and technical agencies accountable to strict budgets, SOWs, and delivery timelines, including cutting agency spend or bringing work in-house.
* Mindset: Pragmatic operator who prioritizes execution and speed-to-market over perfection or unnecessary redesigns.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working across time zones with teams in the US and France.

  
The base pay will be dependent on your skills, work experience, location, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for equity & benefits. ($130,000 - $170,000)

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. What's it like to work at Kinder's? Well, there's a lot of snacking and geeking out over what we all cooked over the weekend. Beyond that, there's also plenty of hard work. Because we don't just like flavor, we're obsessed with it.

Privately held and founder-led, we like to think of ourselves as a pirate ship in a sea of cruise ships. Our crew is adventurous and fearless. We chart our own course and chase big ideas to make food unforgettable.

As we expand globally and approach $1 billion in revenue, we need more smart-and-scrappy, flavor-obsessed people to come aboard. jobs.title: Patient Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
Baywell Psychiatry Group is a growing physician-owned practice of psychiatrists and psychotherapists serving children, adults, and seniors across the SF Bay Area. We offer psychiatric consultations, psychotherapy, and medication management. We take pride in providing high-quality mental health care and providing access to a diverse range of people. You will be the first point of contact for people seeking mental health help and can make a lot of difference for community access.

As a small, close-knit team, we rely on every member to show up fully, pitch in wherever needed, and care as much about the details as we do. If you’re someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, takes initiative, and finds purpose in supporting others, this role is for you.

We’re looking for a motivated, compassionate Patient Services Coordinator to join our San Francisco and San Mateo offices. This is a great opportunity for anyone passionate about mental health or pursuing a future in healthcare as you’ll gain real, hands-on experience in a fast-paced clinical setting.

**This is an in-person and full-time position based in our San Francisco or San Mateo office.**

**What You’ll Do**

This role is phone and email heavy. You’ll be the voice of Baywell, often the first person a patient speaks with, sometimes during emotionally difficult moments in their lives. We’re looking for someone who can bring warmth and calm to every interaction without absorbing the emotional weight of those conversations.

Because we’re a small business, no two days look exactly alike. You’ll be expected to jump in on whatever the team needs, big tasks or small, and shift priorities quickly when the situation calls for it. Specific responsibilities include:

* Serving as the primary point of contact for patients by phone - answering calls, scheduling appointments, and creating a warm, professional experience
* Coordinating communication between patients, physicians, and the administrative team via phone, email, and fax
* Guiding new patients through the intake process, educating them about their health insurance benefits, and welcoming them to the office
* Maintaining and managing physician and therapist schedules with accuracy and flexibility ensuring doctor calendars are full
* Processing prescription refills and prior authorization requests
* Handling day-to-day administrative tasks including insurance coordination, record-keeping, and faxes
* Jumping in to support teammates and cover tasks outside your usual scope when needed - we have a small team and everyone contributes
* Adapting quickly as priorities shift throughout the day, staying organized and composed under pressure
* Supporting our clinical team so they can focus on delivering exceptional patient care

**What We’re Looking For**

The right candidate brings more than administrative skills – they bring emotional intelligence, flexibility, and a commitment to showing up for their team and their patients.

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, especially over the phone – you’ll be warm, clear, and professional even when a caller is distressed or frustrated
* A small-business mindset – you’re comfortable with ambiguity, willing to take on any task that comes your way, and don’t wait to be asked twice
* Emotional resilience – you’ll be able to be present with patients dealing with difficult situations without taking on their emotional distress or solving their problem
* Strong adaptability – you can shift gears gracefully when priorities change throughout the day
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow requests and projects all the way to the end
* A dependable, consistent work ethic and a professional demeanor
* Ability to work both independently and as a close collaborator on a small team
* Genuine sensitivity to mental health issues and a firm commitment to patient confidentiality
* A bachelor’s degree is preferred (coursework or interest in psychology, pre-med, business, or a related field is a strong plus)
* Experience in a medical office or small business setting is a plus
* Proficiency with computers and Google Workspace; familiarity with medical practice management software is helpful

This role is especially well-suited for candidates with clinical aspirations – the experience you gain here is directly applicable to a career in healthcare.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Salary: $25–$27 per hour, depending on experience

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with matching
* Life insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Paid time off
* Mentorship and education opportunities from our physician and senior admin team members

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8-hour shifts in-person in our San Francisco or our San Mateo office. We are looking for someone who can take over the 8am-4:30pm opening shift in San Francisco.

**To Apply**

Please submit the following for immediate consideration:

* A cover letter telling us why this role interests you and what you’d bring to our team
* Your resume
* Two or more professional references

We’re looking for a long-term team member and value candidates who demonstrate stability, focus, and interest in mental health care. We warmly welcome applicants who are newer to the workforce but eager to grow.

*Baywell Psychiatry Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

This position leads program staff, education, equipment and asset management, vendor performance, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement initiatives. The Program Manager partners with clinical and operational leaders to advance patient mobility, reduce employee injuries associated with patient handling, and promote safe, consistent patient movement practices. The Program Manager is accountable for program development, implementation, evaluation, and sustainability across inpatient and ambulatory settings. Responsibilities include personnel management, budget and capital planning, policy development, data analysis, contract oversight, and organizational reporting.

Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley

* Communicates program performance, risks, resource needs, and recommendations to organizational leadership.

* Develops staffing plans based on patient needs, service demand, organizational priorities, and available resources.
* Conducts regular staff meetings, rounding, and individual check-ins to support communication, engagement, and performance improvement.
Partners with Human Resources and department leadership on workforce planning and employee relations matters.  

  

**Education and Competency**

  

* Oversees the development, delivery, and evaluation of safe patient handling and mobility education.
* Ensures completion of new hire education, annual competency requirements, unit-based training, champion development, and specialty training.
* Establishes competency standards for Program staff and monitors successful completion.
* Evaluates education outcomes using competency results, compliance data, injury trends, operational performance, and participant feedback.
Partners with organizational education teams to integrate safe patient handling, create job aids, and mobility content into appropriate learning programs.  

  

**Equipment, Financial, and Contract Management**

  

* Oversees the lifecycle management of safe patient handling and mobility equipment, including selection, acquisition, deployment, inspection, maintenance, repair, replacement, and retirement.
* Develops and manages operating and capital budget recommendations based on program needs, equipment condition, service demand, and organizational priorities.
* Monitors expenditures, service costs, and resource utilization and develops business cases for staffing, equipment, technology, and program growth.
* Partners with Clinical Engineering, Supply Chain, Bio Med, Environmental Services, and clinical departments to maintain equipment availability, readiness, and appropriate use.

**Quality, Safety, Compliance, and Analytics**

  

* Maintains Program compliance with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, and organizational policies.
* Reviews patient-handling-related employee injury data and collaborates with appropriate partners to identify contributing factors and corrective actions.
* Develops and monitors performance measures related to employee safety, patient mobility, equipment utilization, education compliance, service responsiveness, and operational effectiveness.
* Conducts audits and program assessments to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Uses operational and financial data to evaluate program performance and guide decisions.
Develops dashboards, reports, and presentations for organizational leadership and Program stakeholders.  

  

**Organizational Partnership**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

San Francisco, CA | Full-Time (32 hrs/wk) | Non-Exempt | In-person

#### **Schedule:**

* **School Year:** Monday–Friday (32 hrs/wk)
* **Summer:** Monday – Friday | 8:45 AM – 5:45 PM (40 hrs/wk)

#### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character, community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a school-based team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

#### **What You’ll Do**

As a Program Leader at our Carver Elementary School-Based Club, you will play a crucial developmental role in shaping the lives of youth in our community. Rooted in strong relationships with members, school faculty, and families, this role oversees department activities and manages groups of children. You will facilitate engaging after-school activities, design age-appropriate curriculum, manage positive youth behavior, and mentor participants while collaborating with colleagues to meet program goals.

* **Program Facilitation & Lesson Planning**  
  + Create, organize, and lead engaging after-school programs and activities for groups of approximately 10 youth participants.
  + Develop age-appropriate lesson plans and curriculum that promote personal growth, educational achievement, and character development.

  + Provide a safe, structured, and nurturing environment for all youth participants.
  + Serve as a positive role model and mentor, fostering self-esteem, goal-setting, and personal development.
  + Establish Clubhouse standards and expectations grounded in mutual respect between staff and the community served.
  + Apply positive behavior management and disciplinary skills to maintain high expectations in a high-paced environment.
* **Team Collaboration & Operations**  
  + Collaborate with junior-level colleagues to share best practices, ensure program targets are met, and support team cohesion.
  + Maintain operational systems, routines, and record-keeping in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions.

* Minimum 2 years of youth development experience working with youth ages 6–18 in a youth development setting
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, positive relationships with youth and design engaging curriculum
* Strong positive behavior management and disciplinary skills while maintaining high expectations
* Excellent communication, organizational, and self-starter abilities
* Ability to create, implement, and maintain systems and procedures in a fast-paced environment

* Proven leadership or mentorship experience
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or ability to obtain within 90 days of employment)
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a 10-passenger vehicle
* Bilingual skills (highly encouraged)

#### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

* Education Assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
* Mandatory Summer + Winter Weeklong Organization-wide Closures

Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or top level of the range depending on qualifications and position requirements.

The Privacy and Data Protection Office (PDPO) leads and supports TikTok's global privacy efforts, making sure privacy is protected across our products, platforms, and technologies. As a technical privacy center of excellence, we partner closely with engineering, product, legal, and compliance teams to identify privacy risks and design effective technical safeguards throughout the software development lifecycle. At TikTok's scale, protecting user data means going beyond compliance to find complex privacy vulnerabilities and emerging risks across highly distributed products and systems. We combine privacy engineering, security engineering, penetration testing, red teaming, and secure code review to surface those risks, develop mitigations, and build scalable automated assessment capabilities that protect privacy without slowing product innovation. You will work at the intersection of privacy, security, and engineering, on real-world privacy challenges at global scale, influencing how privacy is built into products from the ground up. About the Role: We are seeking a Privacy Program Manager to join our PDPO team as an audit expert and liaison, primarily supporting our product team. In this role, you will translate complex audit requirements into actionable processes. You will ensure our product teams consistently achieve regulatory compliance and remain fully audit-ready. The Incident and Escalation Management team (IEM) is part of Datadog's Global Support Engineering (GSE) organization. We're looking for experts with a background in incident management and escalation handling to provide fast incident response, clear ownership, and calm, confident communication for our global customer base.

  

In this individual contributor role, you will play a key part in customer communication, technical engagement, and incident management for our global customers. You will also implement processes and automations, use the same incident and case management tools we build for our customers, and help shape how they evolve.

  

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Drive incidents and escalations to resolution from start to finish, including triage, coordination with our support, engineering and product teams. Own the response and keep customers and internal teams informed throughout.
* Independently coordinate cross-functional stakeholders through complex incidents and escalations, making the call on prioritization, response strategy, and when to pull in additional teams or leadership.
* Own communications during active incidents, including sensitive, large-scale, and publicly visible events, adapting the message for customers, internal teams, and leadership.
* Lead projects that deliver operational improvements to how IEM detects, manages, and communicates during incidents and escalations as Datadog and its products evolve.
