jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is looking for a Manager, Technical Account Management to build and lead the team of Technical Account Managers who own the technical relationship with our customers. Your team is accountable for how each customer deploys, adopts, and gets value from Cyberhaven's Agentic Data Security platform, from onboarding through renewal. You will hire and develop the team, define how TAMs work with accounts, and make sure customers get a consistent, proactive technical partner and experience.

You are a people leader with a technical background in security SaaS and endpoint agents, and you are comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where the team's processes are still being written. You will coach TAMs on and step in on critical escalations when needed. You will also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support Engineering, Customer Experience, and Sales to turn what the team learns from customers into improvements to the product and to how we serve customers.

Technical depth, a strong client focus, and experience leading customer-facing technical teams are required. You will report to the VP of Support and Technical Account Management.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead and grow the team**

* Hire, onboard, and develop Technical Account Managers. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, and run career development and performance reviews.
* Coach TAMs on account strategy, technical troubleshooting, executive communication, and managing difficult customer situations.
* Build a team culture of growth mindset, ownership, curiosity, and accountability for customer outcomes.
* Plan headcount and coverage as the customer base grows, including how accounts are assigned and balanced across the team.

### **Define how the TAM function operates**

* Establish the TAM operating model: account segmentation, coverage, engagement cadence, business review format, and technical success plans.
* Set the team's goals and metrics, such as account health, agent coverage and deployment progress, adoption, escalation volume and time to resolution, and customer satisfaction. Report on them to leadership.
* Create and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base standards so TAMs handle common situations the same way.
* Define the handoffs between TAMs and Customer Experience and Sales so customers always know who owns what.

### **Own customer outcomes**

* Review account health across the team's book of business and step in early on accounts at risk of low adoption, deployment problems, or churn.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues. Make sure TAMs bring clear reproductions and context to Engineering, and that customers stay informed through resolution.
* Build relationships with customes, and join executive and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Work with Customer Success and Sales on renewals, expansions, and risk mitigation, providing technical input and account insight.

### **Be the voice of the customer**

* Collect customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring issues from the team and bring them to Product Management and Engineering with the technical and business context behind them.
* Work with Engineering and Support Engineering to improve diagnostics, debugging tools, and escalation processes.
* Run root cause analysis reviews on significant incidents and drive preventive follow-ups so issues do not repeat.
* Stay current on industry trends, security best practices, and adjacent technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, and UEBA, and bring them into the team's guidance to customers.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Account Managers, Support Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or similar customer-facing technical staff.
* 7+ years in customer-facing technical roles.
* Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical people, and of handling performance issues directly and fairly.
* Experience building or scaling a TAM, Support, or Customer Success function, including processes, playbooks, and metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to own customer technical outcomes from implementation through steady-state operation, and to understand a customer's architecture and environment end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.
* Proven experience managing escalated technical customer issues and working directly with engineering teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English), including the ability to engage both hands-on practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, set timelines, and track progress across a team and its accounts.
* Practical knowledge of networking, security products, enterprise network infrastructure, and Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint management (SCCM, GPO, Intune, MDM, and application management).
* Ability to read and interpret logs and diagnostic output across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Google Kubernetes Engine well enough to coach others and guide technical investigations.

### **Desired**

* Familiarity with adjacent technologies that Cyberhaven integrates with (SIEM, SOAR, UEBA).
* Expertise with DLP, Insider Threat, and CASB solutions.
* Prior experience leading a TAM team at a security or SaaS company.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth company where the team's processes were still being defined.
* Background in L2/L3 or Escalation Engineering for EDR or DLP tools.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.title: SharePoint Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
SharePoint Implementation and Microsoft 365 Solutions SpecialistProfessional Summary

Experienced SharePoint and Microsoft 365 professional with a strong focus on **end-to-end SharePoint implementation, solution design, workflow automation, and business process improvement**. Skilled in analyzing business requirements, designing scalable SharePoint solutions, implementing and configuring SharePoint sites and components, and integrating Microsoft 365 technologies to improve operational efficiency, information management, and cross-functional collaboration. Experienced in SharePoint Online administration, governance, permissions management, security, migration, modernization, and ongoing production support. Proven ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and technical partners to translate business needs into effective, secure, and sustainable technology solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* **SharePoint Implementation and Solution Delivery:** Lead and support end-to-end SharePoint implementations, including requirements gathering, solution architecture, site design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-implementation support.
* **SharePoint Site Design and Development:** Design, build, configure, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, site collections, document libraries, lists, metadata, content types, forms, web parts, navigation, and collaboration solutions tailored to business requirements.
* **Business Requirements and Analysis:** Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, analyze, validate, and document requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications, technical designs, and implementation plans.
* **Workflow Automation:** Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automated workflows using SharePoint, Power Automate, and related Microsoft 365 technologies to streamline approvals, notifications, document routing, task assignments, and business processes.
* **Business Process Optimization:** Evaluate existing business processes and SharePoint environments to identify inefficiencies, content management challenges, collaboration gaps, and automation opportunities; recommend and implement solutions that improve productivity and user experience.
* **SharePoint Governance and Security:** Establish and maintain SharePoint governance frameworks, standards, naming conventions, site provisioning procedures, lifecycle management practices, permission models, access controls, and external sharing policies in alignment with corporate security requirements.
* **SharePoint Environment Assessment:** Assess existing SharePoint environments, including site architecture, information structure, content organization, usage patterns, permissions, sharing configurations, and governance gaps; develop and execute recommendations for improvement.
* **Migration and Modernization:** Lead or participate in SharePoint migration, implementation, modernization, consolidation, and enhancement initiatives, supporting content migration, site restructuring, permissions validation, testing, and business continuity.
* **Microsoft 365 Integration and Administration:** Administer, configure, and support SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Power Platform, to deliver integrated business solutions.
* **Documentation and Technical Specifications:** Develop and maintain functional and technical specifications, solution design documents, workflow diagrams, governance plans, implementation procedures, user guides, and operational documentation.
* **Testing and Deployment:** Perform functional testing, workflow validation, user acceptance testing coordination, issue resolution, deployment planning, and post-implementation validation to ensure SharePoint solutions meet business and technical requirements.
* **User Support and Troubleshooting:** Provide technical support, diagnose and resolve SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues, manage access and permissions requests, and support ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of implemented solutions.
* **Training and User Adoption:** Develop training materials, conduct demonstrations, and provide end-user guidance to promote adoption of SharePoint solutions, document management practices, automated workflows, and Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities.
* **Stakeholder and Project Collaboration:** Serve as a liaison between business units, IT teams, project managers, vendors, and technical stakeholders to coordinate solution delivery, manage requirements, communicate implementation progress, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* **Continuous Improvement and Technology Evaluation:** Monitor emerging SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform capabilities; evaluate new features and recommend enhancements that strengthen governance, security, automation, scalability, and collaboration.

Core Technical Competencies

* SharePoint Online implementation and administration
* SharePoint site architecture, configuration, and customization
* SharePoint lists, libraries, metadata, content types, and permissions
* Power Automate workflow development and business process automation
* Microsoft 365 integration and administration
* Microsoft Teams and OneDrive collaboration solutions
* SharePoint governance, security, and access management
* SharePoint migration, modernization, and environment assessments
* Requirements analysis and functional and technical specifications
* Testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support
* User training, technical documentation, and change management
* Business process improvement and stakeholder engagement

Pay: $60.00 - $85.00 per hour

At **Havenly Brands**, we're building this generation's premier destination for all things home. Alongside our award winning Havenly design services, we proudly own and operate some of the best home furnishings brands in the business including Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, Burrow, Inside, and St. Frank. Our family of brands is growing and we're looking for amazing people to join us on this journey!

Havenly is not just the #1 residential interior design service in America - we're architecting the future of how millions design their homes. With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. This isn't just another operations role, it's the opportunity to build the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.  
  
**Our Core Values**

* **Exhibit Gumption:** meet every challenge with spirit and energy; believe the impossible is possible.
* **Overperform:** work hard, move fast, be scrappy.
* **Stay Playful:** no jerks, no whiners; have fun and keep perspective.
* **Act Like an Owner:** be accountable, speak up, act in Havenly's best interest.

### **About the Role**

As our CX Team Operations Specialist, you'll own the day for one of our brand CX teams: queue health, work rebalancing, daily huddles, the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve, and coverage when the Team Lead, Customer Experience (your manager) is out. This is an operations role, not a people-management role: no direct reports, coaching, check-ins, performance management, hiring decisions, staffing plans or team KPI ownership, which all stay with the Team Lead. The person we're looking for is a steady, organized, solutions-oriented go-to who keeps queues healthy, makes sound policy-aligned calls on tough cases, and stays close to customers by handling contacts 40 to 50% of the time.

**What You'll Own**

* Monitor queues, channels and backlogs throughout the day, flagging volume spikes, aging tickets and SLA risk.
* Rebalance work across the team as directed by the Team Lead.
* Run daily huddles and share updates, policy changes and known issues.
* Provide coverage and continuity for day-to-day operations when the Team Lead is out of office.
* Share a short end-of-day read on queue health and open issues with the Team Lead.
* Take the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve and own them through to resolution.
* Make sound, policy-aligned decisions on exceptions using the same refund, credit and exception approval authority as the Team Lead, and know when to escalate further.
* Partner with the Team Lead on the most sensitive escalations, bringing clear case summaries and recommended solutions.
* Act as the go-to resource during the day for questions on policies, procedures and systems.
* Guide agents through tricky cases in the moment, and share observations on agent strengths and gaps with the Team Lead, who owns coaching.
* Support onboarding as a buddy for new team members.
* Coordinate with internal partners, especially Logistics and Order Operations, to resolve day-to-day issues on individual orders and cases.
* Spend 40 to 50% of your time handling customer contacts via email, chat, SMS and phone, delivering clear, timely and empathetic communication focused on first-contact resolution, in each brand's unique voice.

**What You'll Drive**

* Identify recurring escalation themes and share them with the Team Lead to inform training and process updates.
* Reinforce established processes and quality standards, and keep team reference materials current in partnership with Systems and Tools.
* Gather frontline feedback on technical, product and marketing program issues and pass it to the Team Lead.

### **We Are Looking for People Who**

* Have **2+ years** of hands-on experience in Customer Experience, Customer Support or a related role (ideally in e-commerce or home goods), including handling escalations and complex customer issues with empathy and sound judgment.
* Bring experience as a subject matter expert, team buddy or acting lead supporting peers day to day, plus hands-on experience with modern CX tools (e.g., Kustomer, Gladly, NetSuite), including macros and knowledge bases.
* Bring a basic understanding of how fulfillment and logistics operations affect the customer experience, strong problem-solving skills, the ability to stay calm and organized in a fast-paced environment, and excellent written and verbal communication.
* Approach ambiguous problems by figuring out what's broken and acting on it, not waiting to be told what's next.
* Move fast, take real ownership of outcomes, and hold themselves to a high bar.
* Collaborate well across teams, with a low-ego, no-drama approach to getting things done.

Bonus points if you also have experience with **monitoring queues or real-time operations in a contact center**.  
  
At Havenly, we're building with AI as part of how we work. We're looking for people who are genuinely curious about AI-assisted tools and eager to adopt them; this is about openness, not existing expertise.

### **The Details**

Talkiatry is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Clinical Recruitment Marketing & Events** to sit at the intersection of Marketing and Talent Acquisition, driving the strategy and execution of national psychiatrist and Advanced Practice Provider (APP) recruitment events. This role builds trust-based relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs, including program directors, faculty, and trainees, across the country, translating those relationships into a strong pipeline of clinicians who will join Talkiatry post-training.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role for someone who combines event strategy, marketing execution, and recruitment expertise to deliver measurable outcomes that support clinical excellence and organizational growth.

**About Talkiatry:**
--------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 800+ psychiatrists, 300+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

### **Residency and Fellowship Program Outreach and Events**

* Serve as a brand ambassador for Talkiatry; engage trainees and build relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs nationwide, including program directors, faculty, program coordinators, chief residents, and chief fellows.
* Build and grow a national footprint of target programs, prioritizing outreach based on program size, specialty focus (e.g., child & adolescent, addiction, forensic psychiatry), and geography.
* Plan and execute dinners, social events, and virtual events for residents and fellows, and deliver ongoing clinical education and clear introductions to Talkiatry's practice management model, incentives, and a transition-to-practice pathway for those nearing graduation.
* Articulate Talkiatry's mission and core values in ways that resonate with program leaders.
* Maintain long-term relationships with program leaders to support annual visits (virtual or in person) and serve as a consistent, credible point of contact throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Use various tools and databases to connect with residency/fellowship program contacts, and track all contacts and outreach in the ATS/CRM.
* Collaborate with marketing on presentation materials, collateral, and e-invites.
* Own full-cycle event planning and track fiscal activities associated with each event.
* Attend residency and fellowship events as needed.

### **Networking Event Planning for Practicing Providers**

* Plan and execute virtual career/open house events:

  + Partner with marketing on content development and preparation.
  + Drive event advertising and psychiatrist outreach via social media, email blasts, etc.
  + Create event invitations and manage registration.
  + Ensure the technology platform is arranged and functioning.
  + Staff events with members of the Talkiatry clinical team.
* Plan and execute in-person networking events, some of which are associated with conferences.
* Track fiscal activities associated with each event.
* Attend conferences as needed.

### **Conference and Event Strategy & Execution**

* Conceptualize event themes and formats tailored to each psychiatry residency/fellowship program's needs and goals.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Sales Operations Manager**

**THE ALBA GROUP** | Commercial | Houston, TX

**Title**

Sales Operations Manager

  

**Company**

Alba Wheels Up International (the Alba Group)

  

**Reports to**

Alexandra Kleinschmidt, EVP Commercial

  

**Location**

Houston, TX (confirm onsite, hybrid or remote)

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

  

**Scope**

Commercial operations across all five Alba Group brands

  

**Systems**

HubSpot, Revenue Vessel, Clarity / Power BI (reporting), advanced Excel, AI tools. CargoWise and netCHB a plus.

**ABOUT THE ALBA GROUP**

The Alba Group is a national customs brokerage, freight forwarding and trade compliance platform backed by Southfield Capital. We operate five brands: Alba, Advance Customs Brokers International (ACB), John A. Steer Company, The Perishable Specialist (PSI) and Cobalt Wine Logistics.

Our clients are importers in perishables and fresh produce, retail and apparel, wine and spirits, and semiconductors and electronics. We win on expertise and value-add solutions, not on rates. We are building one commercial engine across all five brands, and this role sits at its center.

**THE ROLE**

The Sales Operations Manager owns the commercial data, process and coordination behind the Alba Group's sales and account management teams. You make sure our CRM data is right, our sellers walk into client conversations with real importer insight, and our internal meetings happen on time with the right people in the room.

You work alongside our sales support coordinator, who handles day-to-day CRM updates. You own the standards, the processes and the analysis. You partner daily with the EVP Commercial, sales, account management, trade advisory, pricing, operations and implementation.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**CRM data management**

* Own the integrity of commercial data in HubSpot across all five brands: accounts, contacts, opportunities and activity.
* Set data standards and guide the sales support coordinator on day-to-day updates so records stay clean and complete.
* Audit data regularly, fix gaps and duplicates, and keep HubSpot aligned with Revenue Vessel.
* Run a weekly pipeline hygiene check for stale deals, missing next steps and past-due close dates, and send each seller their list.

**HubSpot dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain HubSpot dashboards and reports for sales, account management and leadership.
* Pull and interpret revenue reporting from Clarity / Power BI to support commercial reviews.

**Importer analysis and prospecting**

* Analyze importer activity using trade data and importer intelligence tools: volumes, ports, origins, commodities, current brokers and forwarders.
* Use advanced Excel and AI tools to work through large importer data sets quickly.
* Turn that analysis into clear inputs so sales and account management can build targeted client proposals.
* Build target prospect lists by vertical for the sellers and the LATAM SDR using importer data.
* Support prospect research and account planning with data on where each client or prospect is growing.

**Account management reporting**

* Run regular reports for account management to identify downtrending accounts as early as possible.
* Flag shifts in shipment volume, NR and activity so account managers can act before an account is lost.
* Pull shipment, spend and trend data for key-account quarterly business reviews (QBRs). Account managers remain responsible for building and presenting their QBR.
* Track account tiering, assignments and portfolio NR targets in the account management program.

**Proposal and RFP coordination**

* Own the proposal and RFP calendar so deadlines are visible and nothing is rushed.
* Gather inputs from pricing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage and trade advisory, and route them to the proposal owner on time.
* Maintain a library of approved proposal templates, service descriptions and client case studies.

**Process ownership**

* Help design, document and roll out commercial processes, from lead to quote to onboarding handoff.
* Keep process documents, playbooks and templates current as the business changes.
* Partner with pricing and implementation so handoffs are clean and nothing falls through the cracks.

**Internal meeting coordination**

* Serve as the internal connector between sales and the other groups: operations, trade advisory, pricing and implementation.
* Organize and schedule client prep meetings, internal reviews and pipeline calls well in advance, so nothing is last minute.
* Set agendas, confirm attendees and materials, and track follow-ups to completion.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations or commercial analytics in a B2B environment.
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, including building dashboards and reports and managing data quality.
* Experience with Revenue Vessel and with pulling reports from Clarity / Power BI.
* Strong analytical skills with data management and trade data tools.
* Advanced Excel: pivot tables, lookups, Power Query and building models from raw data.
* Proficient with AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude to speed up analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Highly organized. Comfortable coordinating meetings and calendars across several teams and senior leaders.
* Clear, concise communicator who can turn data into a story sales can use.
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, analytics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Background in logistics, freight forwarding, customs brokerage or trade compliance.
* Experience with importer data and trade intelligence platforms.
* CargoWise and netCHB experience.
* Experience running account health or churn reporting.
* Spanish proficiency.

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Data quality: share of HubSpot records meeting data standards.
* Early warning: downtrending accounts flagged before NR loss compounds.
* Proposal support: importer analysis and proposal inputs delivered

**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Operations Manager to lead and optimize our supply chain and distribution functions. This pivotal role involves overseeing end-to-end operations, driving process improvements, and ensuring seamless coordination across warehousing, transportation, and logistics teams. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in supply chain management, team leadership, and operational excellence, with a passion for continuous improvement and efficiency. Join us to shape innovative solutions that elevate our operational performance and customer satisfaction.

**Duties**

* Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of distribution operations, including warehouse management, transportation planning, and freight management to ensure timely delivery and cost efficiency.
* Develop and implement process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean methodologies to streamline workflows, reduce waste, and enhance productivity across all operational areas.
* Manage profit & loss statements by monitoring budgets, controlling costs, and optimizing resource allocation to meet financial targets.
* Oversee inventory management systems and inventory control procedures to maintain optimal stock levels while minimizing excess or obsolete inventory.
* Supervise warehouse operations including shipping & receiving, order fulfillment, dispatching, forklift operations, and warehouse safety protocols.
* Coordinate with third-party logistics providers (3PL), NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), procurement teams, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient supply chain flow.
* Utilize ERP systems such as AS400 or equivalent platforms for data analysis, reporting, demand planning, production planning, and supply chain analytics to support decision-making.
* Lead a team of supervisors and operational staff by providing managerial communication, fostering teamwork, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Implement transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS) to optimize logistics routes, freight costs, and warehouse distribution processes.
* Drive initiatives in procurement, purchasing, fleet management, materials management, and distribution management to enhance overall operational efficiency.

**Skills**

* Proven experience in supervising warehouse operations with a strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS) and inventory control techniques.
* Extensive knowledge of supply chain management principles including demand planning, production planning, procurement, freight forwarding (including NVOCC), and distribution operations.
* Expertise in process improvement methodologies such as Lean or continuous improvement strategies to streamline workflows.
* Strong proficiency with ERP systems like AS400 or similar platforms; familiarity with supply chain analytics tools is highly desirable.
* Skilled in transportation management systems (TMS), fleet management software, and logistics management tools for effective transportation planning.
* Demonstrated ability to manage profit & loss statements with budgeting experience; capable of controlling costs while maintaining high service levels.
* Excellent team management skills with supervisory experience leading diverse operational teams in fast-paced environments.
* Effective communication skills for managerial reporting, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of warehouse safety standards including forklift operation certifications; experience with shipping & receiving procedures is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications for reporting and data analysis; familiarity with procurement platforms like Materials Management Systems is advantageous.

Join us as a Senior Operations Manager to lead transformative initiatives that drive operational excellence! Your expertise will empower our teams to deliver exceptional service while continuously pushing the boundaries of efficiency in our supply chain ecosystem.

* 401(k)

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Senior Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. As a senior member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

GoodRx is seeking an Implementation Manager - Data Solutions to join our Pharma Direct team. jobs.description:

The Senior Project Manager owns all aspects of project delivery, from initiation through closure, and works closely with sales, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional delivery teams. Other projects and tasks as assigned.

jobs.title: Patient Services Coordinator / Receptionist
jobs.description:
Be the welcoming voice patients can count on.

MyDocPlus is seeking an entry-level Patient Services Coordinator / Receptionist to support patients and the independent medical practices we serve. You will be a friendly, dependable first point of contact, helping patients get answers, routing requests appropriately, and keeping administrative work organized and accurate. Prior healthcare experience is welcome but not required; we value a willingness to learn, strong service skills, and ownership of your work.

This is more than answering phones. You will balance calls, patient and member messages, inboxes, faxes, follow-ups, and administrative tasks across multiple systems. Training will be provided on our tools and workflows, but success requires careful documentation, timely responses, confidentiality, and proactive communication when you need help.

**What You’ll Own**

· Provide courteous, empathetic phone and written support to patients, members, and practice teams; listen carefully and clarify what each person needs.

· Monitor patient, member, and administrative inboxes throughout the day; respond or route messages within required timelines, including same-day member responses and patient/admin responses within 48 hours.

· Process and route incoming faxes by the end of the day; accurately verify patient details, record interactions, and maintain complete notes and follow-up information.

· Keep daily to-do lists, task queues, and HubSpot activity current; monitor outstanding items and proactively escalate overdue or at-risk work.

· Learn to use practice and administrative platforms such as Ebridge, Hint, Inbox Health, website access logs, and other assigned systems to support membership, billing-related inquiries, and patient coordination.

· Investigate concerns before forwarding them; gather missing information, identify an appropriate next step, and bring a proposed solution when escalating an issue.

· Work collaboratively with teammates and leadership to provide consistent, professional service while protecting patient privacy and practice relationships.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Entry-level applicants welcome; experience in reception, customer service, call centers, or administrative support is helpful but not required.

· Clear, professional verbal and written communication, with patience and empathy when handling frustrated or confused callers.

· Strong organization and time-management skills; ability to switch between calls, messages, and follow-up tasks without losing details.

· Comfort learning multiple computer systems, maintaining accurate records, and following written procedures and response deadlines.

· Sound judgment, attention to detail, respect for confidentiality, and willingness to ask questions or escalate concerns promptly.

· Reliable attendance, accountability, coachability, and a service mindset; healthcare terminology or medical office experience is a plus.

**The Person Who Will Thrive Here**

You are welcoming, curious, dependable, and solution oriented. You listen beyond the surface of a concern, double-check patient information, document what you do, and follow through. If you are unsure of a process or falling behind, you tell your supervisor early rather than waiting to be asked. You communicate respectfully, accept feedback, protect confidential information, and understand that every interaction represents MyDocPlus and the practices we support.

**How We Measure Success**

Success means accurate, compassionate service and consistent follow-through, not simply call volume. We assess response timeliness, same-day fax completion, current notes and task queues, accurate routing and documentation, confidentiality, teamwork, initiative, and proactive escalation. Our team follows defined standards for patient/member/admin inboxes, HubSpot tasks, follow-up logs, and other assigned systems.

**Our Hiring Process**

Qualified applicants may complete a brief screening questionnaire, a customer-service scenario, and a basic written communication or organization exercise, followed by interviews. We look for good judgment, willingness to learn, attention to detail, and the ability to take responsibility for a patient request from start to finish.

**If you enjoy helping people, staying organized, and making sure no request falls through the cracks, we would love to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked in a position requiring you to manage phone calls, emails, customer requests, and multiple computer systems while maintaining accurate records?
* You are managing several patient messages, incoming calls, and administrative tasks. You realize that you may not complete everything by the required deadline. In 3–5 sentences, tell us what you would you do?
* A frustrated patient calls because they have contacted the office twice and have not received a response. In 3–5 sentences, tell us how would you handle the situation?

Work Location: Remote

SHR is a premier technology integrator solving our nation’s most complex modernization and readiness challenges across the defense, federal civilian, and intelligence markets. Our robust portfolio of offerings includes high-end solutions in systems engineering and integration, enterprise IT, including cloud services: cyber, software, advanced analytics, and AI. With an intimate understanding of our customers’ challenges and deep expertise in existing and emerging technologies, we integrate the best components from our own portfolio and our partner ecosystem to deliver innovative, effective, and efficient solutions.

**Position Summary**

SHR Consulting Group is seeking a detail-oriented **Quality Manager** to manage and support the company’s quality, compliance, and continuous improvement programs. This position is responsible for maintaining controlled company documentation, supporting compliance with **ISO and CMMI** standards, and serving as the primary owner responsible and accountable for company certification, surveillance, internal, and external audit activities.

The Quality Manager will lead audit preparation and coordination, ensure required evidence and documentation are maintained, facilitate audit activities, track findings and corrective actions, and maintain year-round audit readiness. The ideal candidate has strong experience with document control, quality management systems, ISO certifications and audits, and CMMI requirements and is comfortable taking ownership of compliance activities from preparation through successful completion. Candidates with experience supporting a government contracting organization in a similar role and who reside in the DC Metro Area are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Audit Ownership & Accountability**

* Serve as the primary point of accountability for SHR’s ISO, CMMI, and applicable quality/compliance audits and assessments.
* Own the audit lifecycle from planning and preparation through audit completion, corrective actions, and closure.
* Develop and maintain annual audit schedules and readiness plans for certification, recertification, surveillance, internal, and other applicable audits.
* Coordinate directly with auditors, assessors, certification bodies, internal process owners, and other stakeholders throughout the audit process.
* Establish audit timelines, requirements, responsibilities, evidence requests, and deadlines.
* Ensure required documentation and objective evidence are complete, accurate, current, appropriately approved, and readily available for auditors.
* Facilitate audit activities, including opening and closing meetings, interviews, evidence requests, follow-up questions, and documentation submissions.
* Maintain ownership of audit findings, observations, nonconformities, and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate corrective action plans with responsible process owners and track remediation through verified closure.
* Escalate overdue, incomplete, or high-risk audit actions when necessary.
* Maintain comprehensive audit records and provide management with regular reporting on audit readiness, findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
* Maintain continuous audit readiness throughout the year, rather than preparing solely in advance of scheduled audits.

**Quality Management & Compliance**

* Maintain and continuously improve SHR’s Quality Management System (QMS) and related management systems.
* Support and monitor organizational compliance with applicable ISO standards, including ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 20000-1, and ISO/IEC 27001.
* Maintain alignment with applicable CMMI practices and maturity-level requirements.
* Conduct periodic compliance and readiness reviews to identify gaps before formal audits or assessments.
* Review processes, policies, procedures, and records for compliance with certification, contractual, and company requirements.
* Work with process owners to address identified deficiencies and improve compliance.
* Ensure organizational processes are documented, implemented, measurable, and supported by appropriate objective evidence.

**Document & Records Control**

* Serve as a primary resource for document and records control across the organization.
* Maintain controlled policies, procedures, work instructions, templates, forms, plans, and organizational documentation.
* Manage document versioning, approvals, revision histories, effective dates, review cycles, and archival requirements.
* Ensure obsolete documentation is appropriately removed or archived and current approved versions are readily accessible.
* Maintain organized repositories for quality records, audit evidence, certifications, policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Conduct periodic document reviews to ensure required materials remain current, accurate, compliant, and properly approved.
* Coordinate with document and process owners to ensure policies and procedures are updated when organizational or compliance requirements change.

**ISO & CMMI Certification**

* Manage organizational preparation for ISO certification, recertification, and surveillance audits and CMMI appraisals and assessments.
* Maintain certification requirements, schedules, evidence matrices, compliance checklists, and documentation repositories.
* Monitor changes to applicable standards and evaluate potential impacts to SHR processes and documentation.
* Coordinate internal readiness assessments prior to formal external audits and appraisals.
* Identify potential compliance gaps and work with responsible departments to remediate issues before external review.
* Maintain certification and appraisal records and track upcoming certification milestones and requirements.

**Quality Assurance Tester**

**Location:** Remote, with a preference for candidates in the Washington, DC Metro area who can participate in local collaboration when helpful  
**Clearance:** Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident and able to obtain a Government Public Trust clearance  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote

Build quality into software that matters. ActioNet is creating a new opportunity for an experienced Quality Assurance Tester to take an influential role in delivering dependable, user-ready solutions. Working alongside clients and development teams, you will shape testing from design through release, combine manual insight with automation, and help teams deliver with confidence.

**Primary** **Responsibilities**

* Partner with clients and development teams to understand system features and shape effective test strategies.
* Create comprehensive test plans and robust test cases that promote reliable, user-ready solutions.
* Turn application user stories and use cases into thoughtful manual and automated test coverage.
* Contribute throughout the design and development process by identifying defects, risks, weaknesses, and inconsistencies early.
* Perform regression, post-release, and post-implementation testing to help maintain solution quality.
* Document and communicate bugs clearly, working with development teams to support timely resolution.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

**About Picus**

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Picus holds a 95% recommendation rate, 4.9 on G2, and 4.8 on Gartner Peer Insights, and is the #1 Leader on Frost Radar for Automated Security Validation.

**About The Role**

Picus is looking for a driven and strategic Channel Account Manager to help grow and scale our partner ecosystem across the West region. Preferred locations include the SF Bay Area or Los Angeles area.

In this role, you will work directly with strategic partners, regional sales teams, and internal stakeholders to drive pipeline generation, deal registrations, and partner-sourced revenue. You will serve as the face of Picus in the field, helping partners position, sell, and support Picus solutions through enablement, joint go-to-market initiatives, and co-sell execution.

This is a highly collaborative, field-facing role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth cybersecurity environment and understands how to build strong, revenue-producing channel relationships.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute a regional channel strategy aligned to Picus’ go-to-market objectives,
* Build and manage relationships with strategic VARs, MSSPs, integrators, and reseller partners across the Northeast,
* Drive partner-sourced pipeline generation, deal registration, and revenue growth,
* Collaborate with regional sales teams on co-sell motions, account mapping, and deal execution,
* Deliver sales and technical enablement for partner sales reps, SEs, and services teams,
* Manage the Picus Partner Enablement Program and ongoing training initiatives,
* Develop and execute joint GTM campaigns, partner events, webinars, and field marketing activities,
* Manage MDF programs and support demand generation initiatives with partners,
* Conduct QBRs, pipeline reviews, and regular business planning sessions with focus partners,
* Build executive-level and field-level relationships within partner organizations,
* Increase partner mindshare and strengthen Picus’ presence throughout the regional partner ecosystem,
* Partner with Picus Sales to maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline tracking for partner opportunities.

**What You Have**

* 5+ years of channel sales, partner management, or account management experience,
* Experience in cybersecurity and/or enterprise SaaS,
* Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue through strategic channel partnerships,
* Strong relationships with leading security-focused partners such as GuidePoint Security, Optiv, SHI International Corp., Presidio, or similar organizations,
* Experience training and enabling partner sales and technical teams,
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills,
* Ability to work independently and execute in a fast-paced, high-growth environment,
* Experience with Salesforce and channel sales processes preferred,
* Willingness to travel throughout the West region (~40%).

**Working at Picus**

Fascinating work - a chance to shape and lead an exciting, fast-growing cyber security segment. Security Validation is a concept that helps organizations evaluate their security posture in a continuous, automated, and repeatable way. This approach allows for the identification of imminent threats, provides recommended actions, and produces valuable metrics about cyber-risk levels.

Unlimited opportunity! We are growing. At Picus, you'll be provided with as much responsibility as you can handle - new career development opportunities constantly arise given our rate of growth.

Global exposure - Get a lot of experience working not only in a fast-growing startup but also interact with customers all around the world.

Be part of a global remote team who is taking on Exposure Validation and a growing market segment.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Robert Half, one of FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For is hiring for a **Customer Experience Analyst** to join the Marketing Customer Experience department.

The Customer Experience Analyst manages the day-to-day execution and analysis of Robert Half’s customer experience listening programs across client and candidate journeys. Responsibilities include administering surveys and feedback channels, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, developing reports and visualizations, and monitoring customer signals across multiple sources. Working with internal teams and external partners, the analyst helps test and improve listening programs and expand the use of automation, text analytics, and AI-assisted analysis. The analyst independently investigates customer experience trends, identifies emerging risks, and recommends improvements to listening programs and reporting processes.

**What You'll Do**

Customer Experience Analysis, Reporting, and Data Quality

* Own recurring customer experience reporting cycles, including data preparation, quality assurance, and development of summaries and materials for CX leadership to present.
* Independently analyze survey results, trends, and segments using appropriate statistical methods.
* Analyze open-text feedback using established coding frameworks, taxonomies, and validation rules.
* Create PowerPoint charts, tables and summaries that explain meaningful patterns, changes, and areas requiring deeper investigation.
* Use text analytics and artificial intelligence tools for theme identification and summarization, validating outputs against source data and established coding standards.
* Support report automation, dashboard maintenance, data-feed validation, and improvements to repeatable analysis and reporting processes.

Customer Experience Listening Program Execution

* Independently manage established customer experience survey programs, including programming, distributions, contact lists, suppression rules, workflows, and ongoing maintenance.
* Test survey links, logic, data capture, and workflow changes before launch and after major updates.
* Lead development, configuration, testing, monitoring, and analysis of digital intercepts in partnership with internal teams and external vendors.
* Engage with vendors and internal partners on troubleshooting, testing, and specialized program enhancements. Will maintain program documentation.

Customer Experience Signal Monitoring, Research, and Program Support

* Synthesize feedback, interaction, behavioral, and operational data when available to support broader customer experience investigations.
* Lead focus groups and individual interviews with clients and candidates through scheduling, notetaking, organization, and thematic synthesis.
* Conduct customer experience analysis and investigations to answer business questions and support decision-making.
* Monitor dashboards and structured and unstructured data sources for notable changes, emerging themes, and customer friction.
* Review reporting alerts and threshold changes, validate the signal, document findings, and share results with the appropriate team.
* Partner with Customer Experience, Design, Digital, Technology, Data, and other teams to support research and measurement initiatives.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, research, analytics, social sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Previous work/professional experience (Type and # of years): 5+ years in customer experience, customer insights, survey research, market research, analytics, or related work.
* Strong analytical judgment, quantitative and qualitative analysis, data quality, research fundamentals, problem solving, process improvement, and management of recurring workstreams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, collaboration across business, technical, and vendor teams, strong follow-through, curiosity, and attention to detail.
* Minimum Required Technical Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, intermediate experience with Qualtrics or a comparable enterprise survey platform, visualization tools, statistical analysis, including frequencies, cross-tabulations, trend analysis, and related techniques, text analytics, and artificial intelligence-assisted analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Business Resilience Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

#### **The Role**

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

#### **You Will**

* Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.
* Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.
* Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.
* Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.
* Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.
* Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.
* Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

#### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.
* Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).
* Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.
* Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.
* Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.
* A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.
  
  
We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible.

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, tech-forward Customer Success Manager **Central Time Zone preferred** to join our quickly growing team! At Lively, a key differentiator is our customer experience and the amount of care we give to our employer groups. The CSM team provides an outstanding onboarding and ongoing management experience to our employer customers throughout their lifecycle. As a CSM, you will own a portfolio of Lively employer customers to nurture, support, and develop. It is the job of the CSM to increase customer loyalty and value by providing great consultative white-glove service.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers for all account needs.
* Advocate for and assist customers in leveraging modern tools, including AI-powered solutions, to optimize their benefit administration processes and reporting needs.
* Increase value and drive revenue from existing Lively employers by cross selling other Lively products to those who we already have existing relationships.
* Onboard and implement new employer customers to Lively from sign up to funding of accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with customers' third-party vendors, benefits consultants, and brokers.
* Facilitate recurring meetings with customers and brokers as requested.
* Educate customers on Lively configuration options for benefit enrollment, payroll, and reporting.
* Provide client administrators with ongoing enrollment and contribution processing support.
* Respond to all employer inquiries within 1-2 business days at all times.
* Work cross-functionally to support resolution of customer needs and proactively identify trends across customers to inform Lively product and operations teams.
* Create bug reports in Jira for reproducible product issues.
* Facilitate bulk asset transfers from third-party HSA providers to Lively.

  

**Skills & Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in a customer success, implementation, account management, or similar role.
* Experience delivering an exceptional level of customer support to B2B customers.
* Support high customer volume during our busy Open Enrollment season, roughly October through the end of February each year.
* Experience with upselling and cross selling products to existing customers, as well as hitting revenue-generating goals.
* Strong project management, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with a high level of adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced, sometimes unstructured environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Salesforce.

**Demonstrated experience using AI tools and automation platforms to improve customer experience, streamline workflows, and drive efficiency.**

* Tech-savvy and AI-curious experimental mindset with the ability to adopt and advocate for new technologies and systems while focusing on efficiencies.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the qualifications, but feel you would be a good fit for the position.

**Benefits & Perks**

We offer competitive salaries, stock options, medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage. An HSA with employer contribution, FSA, paid parental leave, medical travel benefits, a 401k plan, flexible vacation policy, lifestyle spending accounts, and more!

At Lively, we believe having diverse teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Come join us in our mission to help people optimize their healthcare spending, maximize their savings, and better their livelihood!

**Customer Success Manager**  
(Remote, full-time)

**About the organization**

Founded as a nonprofit organization in 2020, the National Summer School Initiative (NSSI) partners with schools and districts nationwide to accelerate learning and deepen teacher practice through our distinctive summer programming.

NSSI programming offers districts a new approach to building teacher capacity and driving academic gains. Our mentor teacher model connects some of the country's most exceptional educators with teachers across the nation, equipping and inspiring them to deliver discourse-rich math and literature lessons that are rigorous, culturally responsive, and deeply engaging.

Through intensive pre-service training and dynamic weekly professional development sessions, our summer programming focuses on research-proven instructional practices that accelerate learning. We provide teachers and school leaders with the targeted support and hands-on practice needed to elevate their craft. Our core belief is simple: teachers get better faster by observing the best and practicing.

Our comprehensive approach combines daily exposure to excellent curriculum, observation of outstanding mentor teachers, targeted professional development to help teachers across the country improve rapidly and effectively, and exceptional operational support.

Impact and Growth: In 2026, NSSI served approximately 82,000 students. Building from 48,000 students served in 2023, we continue to refine our approach to maximize impact. With a goal of reaching 130,000 students by summer 2029, we are positioned for strategic growth based on our strong track record of results. Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

**About Picus**

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. new_jobs.description:
**About Allogene:**

Allogene Therapeutics, with headquarters in South San Francisco, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T cell (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease. Led by a management team with significant experience in cell therapy, Allogene is developing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” CAR T cell product candidates with the goal of delivering readily available cell therapy on-demand, more reliably, and at greater scale to more patients.

**About the role:**

Allogene Therapeutics is seeking a highly motivated Packaging Operations Manager to support the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of packaging systems, labeling components, and cold chain packaging supporting the manufacture and distribution of Allogene's clinical and commercial cell therapy products. This role helps ensure that packaging and labeling systems for the company’s first product launch comply with GMP, regulatory, and patient-specific requirements while maintaining product integrity throughout manufacturing, cryogenic storage, transportation, and delivery. This role supports the preparation and launch of Allogene’s first commercial cell therapy product.

The position will be located at Allogene headquarters in South San Francisco, CA. The ideal candidate is an individual who is interested in working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative biotech environment with a willingness and ability to successfully take on new challenges.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Packaging Engineering: Own the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of secondary/tertiary packaging systems for cryopreserved cell therapy products, ensuring product quality and protection across manufacturing, storage, shipping, and clinical-to-commercial transitions.
* Cold Chain Packaging Systems: Support the technical performance and qualification of cold chain shipping systems (dry shippers, temperature monitors, data loggers, insulated containers) by managing Validation protocols, thermal mapping, and lane/transportation validation studies, and analyzing shipping data to drive corrective actions.
* Packaging Design and Engineering: Support the technical lifecycle, specifications, and GMP-compliant documentation of printed packaging components (labels, cartons, IFUs, inserts) and lead Allogene's commercial packaging design and validation - including supplier qualification, cryogenic/transport performance testing, artwork and material selection, and packaging-related risk assessments impacting patient material.
* CMO and Supplier Management: manage chosen CMOs for secondary and tertiary packaging, including manufacturers, contract packagers, and contracted cold chain distribution.
* Artwork and Printing Management: Serve as the lead for artwork implementation, verifying manufacturability, packaging compatibility, and specification alignment while supporting change control and collaborating with Regulatory Affairs, Marketing and Quality on approved labeling updates. Manage print suppliers, coordinate printing and troubleshoot printing issues.
* First product launch: Ensure completion of activities to ensure on on-time launch for Allogene’s first commercial product. Coordinate all packaging related launch activities.

**Position Requirements & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Packaging Science, or a related field with at least 3 years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, with a strong preference for cell or gene therapy, package design and development, and/or cold chain management.
* Knowledge of cGMP regulations and regulatory expectations; familiarity with FDA, EMA, and Annex 13 labeling requirements is a plus.
* Familiarity with cryogenic or cold-chain packaging and autologous or allogeneic cell therapy supply chains is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of artwork management and print processes for packaging components.
* Experience with product launches is preferred.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Process Development, and others.
* Ability to effectively work in a fast-paced, biotech environment while dealing with ambiguity.
* Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a desire to improve upon established processes.
* Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S.

We offer a chance to work with talented people in a collaborative environment and provide a top-notch compensation and benefits package, which includes an annual performance bonus, equity, health insurance, generous time off (including 2 annual holiday company-wide shutdowns) and much more. The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 per year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
